Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.text: Sunita says she is calling about painting her flat.
Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.quote: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.text: Ramesh asks which flat it is and how big it is.
Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.quote: Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.text: Sunita says the flat is a 2BHK in Sector 62 Noida and the job is to paint the two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings.
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62 Noida; paint two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.quote: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.text: The worker asks whether the job is only inside work or also includes the balcony and outside.
Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.quote: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the job is only the inside work, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.value: inside work; two coats; putty where needed; Asian Paints Royale
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.text: Ramesh accepts the agreed work as a full inside 2BHK paint job with two coats, putty where needed, and Royale paint.
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.value: full inside 2BHK, two coats, putty, Royale paint
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.quote: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.text: Sunita asks Ramesh how much he will charge.
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.quote: Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna loge?

Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.text: Ramesh says the total for material and labour will be 45,000 rupees.
Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.quote: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.text: The hirer offers 40,000 rupees for the total job.
45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.quote: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.text: The worker says the final price is 42,000 rupees and it cannot be lower.
Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.quote: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita accepts 42,000 rupees as the final total.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita asks whether the material will be provided by the worker.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh says the material will all be his.
Ramesh says he wants some advance before starting the work to buy paint.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Kitna advance?.text: Sunita asks how much advance is needed.

15 hazaar de dijiye advance..text: Ramesh asks for an advance of 15,000 rupees.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita offers to pay 10,000 rupees as advance, not 15,000.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita says the advance will be paid tomorrow by UPI.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Ramesh accepts 10,000 rupees as the advance.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.text: Sunita asks when the rest of the money will be paid.
Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.quote: Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: Ramesh says the rest will be discussed later.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..text: Sunita accepts start Monday, 2026-11-23 for the work.
Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..quote: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: The worker accepts start Monday, 23 November.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: The worker says the work will finish by 30 November.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: Sunita accepts Ramesh's finish date of 30 November by asking "Pakka 30 tak?"
Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.quote: Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: Sunita says her guests are coming on 2 December.
Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.quote: Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.text: Ramesh accepts the agreed finish date as 30 November.
Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.quote: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.text: The hirer asks that the witness has noted everything.
Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.quote: Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says the total is 43,000 rupees.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says 10,000 rupees is the advance and it will be paid tomorrow.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.text: Sunita says the furniture should be covered during the work and cleaning is also the worker's responsibility.
Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.quote: Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will cover everything and leave only after cleaning.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.value: cover everything; clean up before leaving
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita accepts the 10,000 rupees advance by saying she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon. Ab rakhti hoon.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita says she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon. Ab rakhti hoon.

Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.text: The worker says he will come on Monday morning at 9 o'clock.
Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.quote: Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9 baje aa jaunga.

Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.quote: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.
